position_policy: IDs identify factory wiring positions, not the operator of an installed/reworked SIM. Do not filter by current operator or ICCID.

board_3_4_stock_routing.scope: Stock Android module parameters, not the U30 Pro native driver's normalized attributes

board_6_stock_routing.scope: Stock Android module parameters, as for boards 3/4. Board 6 has no card 0; built-in card 2 takes its place on stack 0, unlike board 3 where card 2 is on stack 1

apk.evidence: BoardIdConfigEnum.MU3356_CHIP_CARD_CT_CU_TWO_PHYSICAL_CARD: boardId 6, TWO_CHIP_CARD_TWO_PHYSICAL_CARD, eSIM CT+CU, pSIM 1+2. NetworkSettingUtils.getPhoneIdBySettings returns phone 0 for card 2 only when isMU3356CtCuBordId6Card. needReversePsimMapping stays true, so external 1/2 remain raw cards 4/3

stock_mux_module.evidence: No board_id reference; one selector polarity for every MU3356 board

board_6_stock_routing.validation: Static analysis of the B28 files above, plus a read-only stock Android reading on one board 6 unit: selected card 1, gpio_sim_ctrl select 1, gpio_sim_ctrl_psim 1, no androidboot.simswitch/psimswitch, logical SIM2 loaded. Not booted under OpenWrt on board 6; no card switch, RF or data test has been run on this layout

test_sku_1000_routing: Not verified by the stock framework branches; enum capability alone does not prove mux routing
hardware_validation: Authorized trial-led-pair-20261105 on MU3356 board 4: sources [0,4] -> [3,4] -> [0,4] through real RPC jobs, peer-only changes preserved WAN uptime. DSDS on plus explicit enable confirmed CFUN [1,1]; DSDS off restored [0,1]; single-standby mutual exclusion [1,0], both-off [0,0] and original restore [0,1] passed. IPv4/IPv6 ping each 3/3 before and after RF tests. Actual SIM/LED web views and mobile layouts passed. PMIC white channel registration, brightness and exclusive colour readback passed, but user did not inspect real colours/boot animation. NV writeback off and storage read-only throughout. Normal return to stock Android A completed, original selected card/DSDS/mux confirmed. Two real external cards, OTG and NFC remain unaccepted; not a blanket acceptance for other boards. RF caption follow-up is source/browser tested after Android return, not deployed.

stock_initial_standby.import_policy: Import actual Android card sources on a fresh install. OpenWrt dual_standby defaults off as requested; preserve existing explicit OpenWrt source/RF preferences.
